notes.title: GRAV: Reborn Update 9.8
notes.content:
------- GRAV: Reborn Update 9.8 2017-03-21 21:00 EST -------
 


-NOTICE: Build Costs are now back to normal.  Please try it out and let's see what people think.
 
-NOTICE: Exp Scalar is now back to normal.  Please try it out and let's see what people think.
 
-NOTICE: Area Levels have been re-rerolled.
 



-IMPROVEMENT: More Yetis on new tundra planets.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Mannequins can now be told to do an emote and they will do it forever.  (e.g. hammertime, flex, goaway)
 
-IMPROVEMENT: You can now set your 'Homeplanet' from a Home Stargate menu.
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Reversed order of vehicles in the vehicle factory.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Added New Base Item:  Mannequins
-SHOUTOUT: Srazor
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Better particle for showing that something is stunned (it now loops for the duration of the stun).

-IMPROVEMENT: Added New Base Item:  JumpPad Bumper 

-IMPROVEMENT: New Resource Cagite.  Mostly found at far ends of caves.
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Added New Base Item:  Cagite Harvester!  The only way to harvest the new Cagite Resource!

-IMPROVEMENT: Moved the Percentage of Resource you get from self destructing base items to a .ini file to allow third party servers to modify.
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Moved the Percentage of Resource you get from destroying base items to a .ini file to allow third party servers to modify.

-IMPROVEMENT: Added new Personal Vehicle:  The Speeder!
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Drill platforms now have their flags that are colorized based on player color.

-IMPROVEMENT: Resource grid reversed the order of resources displayed.
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Added Grenades.  Explosive and Stun types.  (drops from Bombers)
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Added New Base Item:  Vehicle Speed Booster. 
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Added New Base Item:  Portable Shield
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Added New Armor Set:  Cagite Armor  (drops from Slime bosses on Mid Planets)

-IMPROVEMENT: Added a Number of Player Head Options
 
-IMPROVEMENT: The WeiWei faction has managed to scrape together enough funds to allow them to have different heads!  Kill a WeiWei has a chance to drop the head currently on said WeiWei.
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Killing A LOT of WeiWeis will now reward a title.
 


-BALANCE: Drill Platforms:  Reduce the plasma fuel costs to ResourceBurnRatePerMinute=4 (was 6).
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BALANCE: Turrets:  Doubled the amount of bullets you get per ore.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BALANCE: AA Turrets:  Doubled the amount of bullets you get per ore.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BALANCE: Loot Crates now drop grenades.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong

-BALANCE: Doubled gem stack size (was 5000 now 10000)
 
-BALANCE: Doubled artifact stack size (was 1000 now 2000)
 
-BALANCE: All 2000 stack size Resources are now 5000.

-BALANCE: Tundra Armor is now stronger (increase item level from 6 to 7)
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong

-BALANCE: Medium BugDogs have had their health lowered some.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BALANCE: Zombie Planet is now Environmental Hazard:  Extreme Toxic

-BALANCE: Increase drop rate of the Hammerhead.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BALANCE: Increase the parked distance for Doom Buggies so they are shielded/parked when they are first created.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BALANCE: Higher level planets now have more resources per resource patch/node.
 
-BALANCE: You now start off with 2 Doom Buggies so if one gets lost you can make another one.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BALANCE: Fixed Turrets have 15 inv slots when fully upgraded.  This forced you to have to go to the next page for just one slot.   They now have 14 inv slots.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong

-BALANCE: Fixed Campfires having wrapped inv slots.
 



-BUGFIX: Fix your harvestors not showing up if you re-enter a planet.
-SHOUTOUT: akimchik
 
-BUGFIX: Fix planet level maxing out at 60 causing some BP drops to be really hard to get.
-SHOUTOUT: Magnificon
 
-BUGFIX: Fix GRAVSystemWideAnnounce is being called on non official servers
-SHOUTOUT: Weerwolf
 
-BUGFIX: Fix Magma Armor not fitting the new player models well.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BUGFIX: Fix Mass Spamming Pet summoning using up pet consumables but not actually summoning a pet.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong (for constantly 'reminding me')
 
-BUGFIX: Fix a case where the server would crash on start up.
 
-BUGFIX: Fix a case an Mob lootbag could be destroyed and now allow item drops to occur.
 
-BUGFIX: Fix bug in tracking the level of mobs killed.  This will fix a number of titles not being given out.

notes.title: GRAV: Reborn Update 9.7.18
notes.content:
------- GRAV: Reborn Update 9.7.18 2017-01-05 19:00 EST -------
 

-IMPROVEMENT: The Female Character model is now active.
 
-IMPROVEMENT: 2017's AllowedDropDates have been updated for special event drops.
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Player Skill List order has been improved.  Unlocked items sorted by Job and then Level Required and then all locked items also sorted by Job and then Level Required.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Ability Skill List order has been improved.  Unlocked items sorted by Job and then Level Required and then all locked items also sorted by Job and then Level Required.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-IMPROVEMENT: Added keybinds to quickly change jobs.
-SHOUTOUT: Dyro_B
 


-BUGFIX: Fix 'leaving a gift' giving you exp.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BUGFIX: Fix SpaceStation soundscape being louder than the rest of the game.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BUGFIX: Fix UI Object leak when a base item is not allowed to be built.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BUGFIX: Fix Building Base Items inside a building near other Base Items being insanely slow.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BUGFIX: Fix Homeplanets getting improperly terminated due to long start up times.
 



-BALANCE: Area Totems can now have a 50% tax rate.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BALANCE: Pekkets will now do a jump attack/jump towards you.
 
-BALANCE: Increase the stack size of Composters.  Still need grow farms but it is not so tedious to make organics.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BALANCE: Reduce the amount of Element-X a fully upgraded harvester can hold.  (was just insane before)
 
-BALANCE: When an Anonymous player joins/leaves a planet we now output a message saying a 'Hiding Player' has joined/left the planet.  You will not know who this player is but at least you will now know to be on your toes.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong
 
-BALANCE: As Harvesters are heavily incentivized to be 'FOF: Public' and that makes the compass just utterly unuseable, we now only show harvesters that you have created yourself.
-SHOUTOUT: GRAV Bong

notes.title: GRAV: Reborn Update 9.7.15
notes.content:
------- GRAV: Reborn Update 9.7.15 2016-11-16 17:30 EST -------



-IMPROVEMENT: Hungarian Localization update!
-SHOUTOUT: István Nagy - Ferenc( Patyek )


-IMPROVEMENT: Italian Localization update!
-SHOUTOUT: Deiv (from Dìendì)





-IMPROVEMENT: New Zombie Slayer Title



-IMPROVEMENT: New Zombie World Planet (Experimental Server only for the moment)



-IMPROVEMENT: New Zombie Boss! Shoot its limbs off to remove the helmet. Then headshots a plenty will take it down.




-IMPROVEMENT: New Emote: 'layback' 









-BALANCE: Rooms which suffered from the wall decay bug will now be refunded back to the owner. This should also fix 'phantom' rooms which had no walls or floors but prevented things from being built.


-BALANCE: Planets with PvP enabled will now spawn much more of the rarer elements, while planets which do not allow PvP will spawn slightly less.



-BALANCE: Increased many of the Title exp rewards by a factor of 20



-BALANCE: Meleeing Zombies will no longer have damage scaled down. Previously, hitting the body would scale the damage.


-BALANCE: Large Zombies can now be hit by Melee attacks. Fossil Armor on zombies means: bulletproof



-BALANCE: Large Zombies now have a knockback attack.





-BUGFIX: Titles from killing mobs, killing players, and building things now work again.



-BUGFIX: Fixed condition where the harvester decay increase for PVE non public harvesters added in previous patch would not happen correctly.


-BUGFIX: Fixed some cases allowing base items to be built through base walls.


-BUGFIX: Fixed players being able to spawn on the other side of walls with purposefully placed uplinks in some cases.



-BUGFIX: Fix being able to one shot yourself via doing damage to BaseItems in PVE
-SHOUTOUT: scarabey77

notes.title: GRAV: Reborn Update 9.7.14
notes.content:
------- GRAV: Reborn Update 9.7.14 2016-10-31 20:00 EST ------- 
  

-NOTICE: We have wiped the homeplanet on Experimental Server so we can see if the bug fix for missing walls was successful. 
 


-IMPROVEMENT: Zombie Crawlers, covered in Fossil Armor immune to Range attacks, have found their way to GRAV.  Get close and melee them 'to death'!



-IMPROVEMENT: New PVE Homeplanet (Tradlor) for AUS. (By popular demand!) 
  

  


-BUGFIX: Fixed a Database issue where not all possible rows were being looked at.  Please look for new bases with missing walls. 
  



-BUGFIX: Fixed some mobs not fading out when they were killed. 
  


-BUGFIX: Fixed high level resources most always being considered a jackpot. 
  

  


-BALANCE: On PvE planets Harvesters will now decay much more quickly if they are not set to PUBLIC 
  

-BALANCE: Increase the delay from when the zombie vomits to when you take damage to allow you to dodge. 
  


-BALANCE: Loot Crate Guards will now venture to lower level areas to guard crates. 
  


-BALANCE: Fix Zombie Vomit being omni directional 
  

-BALANCE: Zombie Vomit from small zombies now does less damage.  Watch OUT for the Large Zombies tho! 
  



-BALANCE: Vomit Clouds delay their damaging until they are fully formed 
  


-BALANCE: Make zombie limbs break off much easier 
  


-BALANCE: Make night on the starter planets brighter. 
  


-BALANCE: Increase damage to Hammer Heads that are flying under the world.

notes.title: Testing Underway for GRAV One Universe Update on Experimental Build
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7139687/0383e2de8aad414ca9efc9ec536faf8e92b88227.gif[/img]

[h1]Hi Everyone![/h1]

I’m excited to bring you some more information regarding the One Universe update. For those interested, you can start testing out parts of the new update right now on the experimental build. When I say “parts”, I mean we are rolling out features to the experimental build one at a time, to make sure everything goes as smoothly as possible when we flip the switch for everyone.

We are currently testing saving to the new back-end to make sure it is rock solid. We want to ensure there will be no data loss when we roll out the update to everyone.

Because of this, we want to stress that if you want to try out the experimental build, we greatly appreciate the help. However, your core experience won’t be drastically different on the test build until we roll out more PRE updates. With that being said, I want to share a few more changes that will be coming with the One Universe update.

[h1]Planet Rotation:[/h1]

The One Universe update will do away with planet rotation.  Before you wield your pitchfork you should know [b]ALL PLANETS[/b] will be up [b]ALL THE TIME![/b] No more waiting for that planet to rotate in, or worrying about building your base on a planet that will not be available all the time.
 
[h1]Some other minor things already going into this update:[/h1]

Cross planet FoF chat is already live and working in the test build.
Additionally we will be adding chat channels so you can better select what chatter you want to hear. Only want to talk to people on your planet? Done! Want to talk to everyone? Done! Players will be able join and create their own chat channels whenever they please.

Lastly, We want to thank you all for your patience. These are big and somewhat scary changes we are making, and we are taking our time to make sure they’re done right.

notes.title: GRAV One Universe Update Details
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/DUKtbAB.jpg]

[h1]Hi Everyone,[/h1]

The One Universe Update we’ve been teasing is on its way. In fact, we’re confident enough to say that you’ll be able to enjoy GRAV with anyone in the world next month! We hope you’re as excited about this update as we are. So much work has been put into this update and we really can’t wait to let you all enjoy it. If this is the first time you’ve heard of the upcoming update, please check out this post: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/332500/announcements/detail/800894401511848987]GRAV One Universe Update[/url]

[h1]A quick recap:[/h1]

All official servers will be linked, creating one official universe! This means you’ll be able to play with anyone in the world without having to create a new character for a different server. 

Because of the technicalities with this update, we will be completely wiping servers. This means everyone will be starting fresh when the update launches. To help jumpstart the leveling up process, we will be holding double XP weekends for the first few weekends following the One Universe update.

[h1]What to Expect After Update[/h1]

We have some more cool stuff we’ve been working on and will be ready to share more information about it after the upcoming update.

Until Next Time, BUILD EXPLORE DANCE SURVIVE

notes.title: Big Update on The Way! Side Note: GRAV is Alive and Well
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/5mweRbq.jpg]

[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

It’s been a while since we’ve shared any news on what’s to come. For this, we apologize. However, this doesn’t mean we haven’t been working. In fact, we’ve been hard at work on some really awesome things and today, I’m finally able to share with you one of the more exciting things coming to GRAV.

In the near future, all official servers will be linked, resulting in one official universe! This means that astronauts from around the world will be able to play together. 

This is something we’ve wanted to do for a while, but knew it would take time to complete. After the Reborn update, we decided that linking all servers into one universe was priority number one.

We want all of you to be able to enjoy GRAV together.

This update should make GRAV a much more enjoyable experience for everyone. 

[h1]What’s Coming After This Awesome Update?[/h1]

While this update is a really REALLY big deal, we understand that you all want more content to enjoy. We want you to know that we are working on it and will be sharing more news at a later date. 

We are incredibly excited to enjoy the GRAV universe with all of you! 

Until Next Time, BUILD EXPLORE DANCE SURVIVE

notes.title: Community Update #13 - Base Building Contest
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/Fo2eaLV.jpg]
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]
Welcome to the 13th community update blog post. If you haven’t read our previous posts, we’ve been running player surveys for a while now and have gotten some excellent feedback. We want to thank everyone who has participated! You’ve been incredibly helpful and have definitely impacted the future of GRAV.

In previous community update blog posts, we’ve announced titles for “creator overlord” and “shutterbug”. Since announcing those titles, we’ve received some excellent submissions and noticed some really awesome screenshots. The submissions have been nothing short of spectacular. 

With that being said, we’ve decided to run a base building contest! We want to see how creative you can be with your buildings. We will be offering prizes to the top-3 bases.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/eaRViKe.jpg]

[h1]GRAV Base Building Contest[/h1]

The rules are simple. Your base cannot exceed 100 blocks/base items. Other than that, you’re free to create whatever your heart desires. 

[h1]How to Enter[/h1]

You can submit your base from now until 4/3/16 11:59 PM EST. Your submissions can be screenshots or videos.

There are 4 ways to enter:

[olist]
[*]Send us an email at logan.williams@bitmonstergames.com with the subject line “GRAV Base Building Contest”
[*]Tweet your screenshot to us, mention @playgrav and use the hashtag #gravcontest
[*]Facebook message your screenshot to us.
[*]Upload your screenshot here in the community discussions with the caption “GRAV Contest Submission”
[/olist]

[h1]Prizes[/h1]

We will be giving out extra GRAV Steam keys to the top 3 bases. You can use these keys however you want. 

First Place: 3 GRAV Steam keys
Second Place: 2 GRAV Steam keys
Third Place: 1 GRAV Steam key

[h1]Rules[/h1]

As stated above, each submitted base has to be 100 block / base items or less. The submissions have to be before 4/3/16 11:59 PM EST.

We will review all submissions and include the winning bases in next week’s community update blog post.

[h1]Dev Blog Updates[/h1]

As you might have noticed, we haven’t been posting as many dev updates as we have community updates. This is about to change. The development team has been working on some cool improvements and we will be sharing information soon. This will be done with our dev updates and not our community updates. 

We’ve noticed confusion in the past from community members that take our community updates as development updates and they are not. The community update posts are to shine a spotlight on you the community. Future development updates will focus on updates/patches or anything development related.

[h1]See You Next Week[/h1]

We look forward to seeing some awesome bases and can’t wait to share them with all of you next week. 


Until next time, EXPLORE BUILD DANCE SURVIVE.

notes.title: Update 8.1 Live!
notes.content:
[h1]GRAV: Reborn, Update 8.1 Notes[/h1]

[b]HAPPY HOLIDAYS: Holiday trees now spawn among the forests complete with presents underneath![/b]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]ESN Localization Update!!!!!
-SHOUTOUT: Jose Carlos De Luque Morales
[*]Right-click to fast move objects between bins and inventory now works both ways
[/list]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed candies only giving movement increases and not the other stim effects.
-SHOUTOUT: PVPenny
[*]Fixed some Drill Platform drops not being able to be picked up. (Some elemental Essences)
[*]Fixed an issue that sometimes caused newly created base items not to get saved
[*]Added failsafe protections against player save data getting zero'd during server crashes
[*]Fixed vehicles sometimes appearing to be where they are not. (which is same issue with them falling through bases until you hit them)
[*]Fixed issues allowing projectile weapons to sometimes be able to be fired through walls 
[*]Fixed switching GearSets setting your HP to the Default HP amount and not keeping your current amount.
-SHOUTOUT: naqaden
[*]A number of fixes on the DrillPlatforms.  Erupting should no longer happen on spawn, correct effects for showing when vulnerable 
[*]Stargating and disconnecting players no longer play death animation/sounds
[/list]

notes.title: GRAV: Reborn Update 8 is live!
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/gBtQHC4.jpg]
[h1]GRAV: Reborn, Update 8 Notes[/h1]

[b]HAPPY HOLIDAYS: Holiday trees now spawn among the forests complete with presents underneath![/b]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]DEU Localization Update!!!!!
-SHOUTOUT: maxunit
[*]The Santa Hat will now drop throughout the holiday season.
[*]Added mute menu. Manage mutes right from the chat box and squelch those annoying chatterboxes.
[*]You can now click to change which room you're interacting with, even if you're already in a room interact menu.
[*]PlayerAbility 'Super Tank' now has its own camera mode.
[*]Force Planet Rotation now sends an alert 10, 5, and then at 1 minute before rotation
[*]The Armory now displays each 'set' of armor on a page ordered the same.  Special boots go at the very end of the list
-SHOUTOUT: rude Dude
[*]The Armory now displays each item from lowest rarity to highest rarity
[/list]


[b]BALANCE:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduce cost of bag summon stim.
[*]Vendroid is now a bit less greedy.
[*]Tweaks to the PVPDamage Scalar.  Basically high levels fighting each other turns into a snooorreeee fest.  So reduce the amount of artifical damage scaling we are doing so that people don't die instantly.
[*]Noob Protection Rank has been raised to help stop the utter slaughter that is still occurring on the Moons.
[*]Vehicles will now be locked (but damageable) for 30 minutes when the driver leaves.
[*]PlayerAbility 'Wingsuit Dive Bomb' protects you from damage on missed dive bombs
[*]On Death, from a Player killing you, you now drop a percentage of Ammo.  The percentage is affected by the Astronaut passive skill: 'Resource Drop Reduction'
[*]On Death, from a Player killing you, you now drop a percentage of consumables (stims, rations, etc.)  The percentage is affected by the Astronaut passive skill: 'Resource Drop Reduction'  If you have 5 or less of a consumable you will not drop any.
[*]Due to much confusion and gnashing of teeth, Doors can no longer be made public.  If you want a public door, don't have a door :)
[/list]


[b]BALANCE:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed home planets not being sorted in home planet stargate menu.
[*]Fixed Kitchenette not having ability to build multiple items at once (this missed update 7)
-SHOUTOUT: LOMS
[*]Monsters will no longer drop empty loot bags occasionally.
[*]Fixed the hotbar being on while in vehicles if you hit shift/ctrl.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause some base items to not fit in certain rooms.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 7 and MERGE happening now
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/TuEGbua.jpg]
[b][h1]SPECIAL NOTICE: We will be merging overflow servers into main servers. All official servers will be down while the merge takes place. We expect this to take longer than our usual update downtime.  Please be patient and we will bring up each server one by one as they are completed.[/h1][/b]

For more information on the merge see this thread:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/332500/discussions/0/494631873669383340/



[h1]GRAV: Reborn Update 7 NOTES[/h1]
[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b] 
[list]
[*]PlayerAbility 'Strip Mine' now has a particle effect.
[*]Added system wide announcement system.
[*]When it's time for a planet to rotate, players will be warned a minute ahead of time and then anyone still on the planet will be moved to their home world to allow the planet to safely rotate.
[*]Drill Platforms now show up on the Compass.
[*]New hat:  Frog Head
[/list]


[b]BALANCE:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Planets will FORCE rotate now.  You will get a warning before they go down.
[*]Drill Platforms have had their Time To Eruption reduced to 4 hours down from 12
[*]Vehicles built at the vehicle factory can no longer be parked by unfriendly players to the owner.
[*]Vehicles built at the vehicle factory can no longer be claimed by other players when they are decaying.
[*]Vehicles built at the vehicle factory will not have their decay timers reset unless a friendly-to-the-owner player enters it.
[*]Harvesters may no longer be built on or in rooms.  Harvesters already built on rooms will be refunded.
[*]Monsters now drop more crafting materials the higher level they are.
[*]Tweak the drop rules for the horsehead masks to make the more rare ones a bit easier to acquire
[*]Tweak the drop rules for consumable Pets.  They were unfairly biasing against the higher level items dropping at the rates we wanted. (e.g. the Bird Wingsuit)
-SHOUTOUT: Mack
[*]Any base item built on a room will now default to FoF security mode.
[*]Base Raiding.  Area Totems costs have been reduced.  We expect people to put them down and for them to be destroyed via EMP shield disabling and then raiding the base.
[*]Base Raiding.  EMP charge time has been reduced to 10 minutes. The duration of the EMP has been reduced to 5 min.
[*]Base Raiding.  Doubled the Health of the EMP
[*]Changed PlaySoul Essence dropping from a Player to once every 24 hours instead of 12
[*]PlayerSoul weapons now cost more PlayerSoul Essence
[*]If a player tries to use a bag summon stim when there are no summon-able bags, the stim will not be taken.
[/list]



[b]BALANCE:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Fixed not being able to use just claimed base items that were previously decaying.
[*]Fixed heads disappearing when removing hats on clients.
[*]Fixed dropped items falling through bases.
[*]Fixed base item level decals not updating with the level of the base item.
[*]Fixed friendly/unfriendly color coding on base items.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause base items built inside a room to poke out of the side.
[*]Fixed items right clicked from bags/bins disappearing if your inventory is full
[*]Base Raiding.  EMPs now should be activatable
[*]Fixed some pathing issues in the Ice Caves
[*]Fixed players dropping additional elemental BPs
[*]A number of the NightKiller Crafting Materials had incorrect names.  You will not lose any Crafting Materials.  But the names will be changed to match the icons.
[*]Fixed a dupe bug
[*]Fixed upgrading costing less than it should.
-SHOUTOUT: Beast Incarnate
[*]Fixed Sana hats not dropping
-SHOUTOUT: Mack
[*]Fixed a vehicle exploit
-SHOUTOUT: evilmrfrank
[*]Fixed being able to change the Security Mode on Area Totems and Drill Platforms
[*]PlayerSoul inadvertently lost their scalar for requiring more Essence than normal Elemental Weapons/Armor
[*]Fixed Respawning from Death starting you with Level 0 starting HitPoints.
[*]Fixed dropped items falling through rooms
[/list]

notes.title: Community Rules & Guidelines
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We just want to make a quick announcement about community guidelines and rules. From now on, we will be following the [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=4045-USHJ-3810]rules & guidelines for Steam forums[/url] more vigorously. We want the GRAV community to be a place where players (and interested players) go to share ideas, suggestions and help each other in a constructive and healthy atmosphere. 

Lately there have been many posts that have been less than helpful, polite, or constructive. To be clear; It’s fine to disagree with us, hate on the game, debate choices we make etc., but combative, needlessly negative or harassing posts are not going to be tolerated. Below are some examples of what we want to correct and ways that we will handle this kind of behavior:

[list]
[*]If members get combative/name calling with each other or with us: 1 month ban from forums and block from chat.
[*]If members swear at others or us: permanent ban
[*]If members repeatedly ask the same question despite having been given an answer: warning, then ban.
[/list]

The types of behavior found above don’t help anyone and it makes it hard for people with legitimate concerns/questions to get through the noise.

Also, we will be taking steps to better communicate with all of you, not only on the Steam forums, but also our [url=https://www.facebook.com/playgrav]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/playgrav]Twitter[/url] and recently re-designed [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/grav/]Subreddit[/url]. 

We hope you won’t view this post as an affront. We are very grateful to have a passionate community. Sometimes we just need to remind everyone that we are working on a constantly improving Early Access game and we want to make sure everyone in the community has an opportunity to contribute.

notes.title: Official Server Merge Information
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As you all know, the overflow servers from the free weekend are going to be merged into official servers soon. If you didn’t know this, check out this post [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/332500/discussions/0/496881136902384187/]here[/url]

However, there have been plenty of discussions focused on this and I would like to present all of you with the absolute facts. 

[h1]1.)	When is the server merge happening?[/h1]

Answer: Very soon. I know that’s not the answer you’re all looking for. However, I could tell you it will happen within a week, but that will only bring speculation on which day. I can say that it will happen before the year is up. Does this mean it’s going to happen on December 30? Nope, it could, but most likely nope. Could it happen on December 5? Absolutely. The point I’m trying to make is that we seriously would love to give all of you an exact date and time, but we just don’t have it at the moment. We won’t fill you full of dates, if we don’t have them set in stone.

Also, you will have at least a 24 hour warning before this happens.

[h1]2.)	Will my character be transferred over?[/h1]

Answer: Absolutely.

[h1]3.)	What about my resources and items?[/h1]

Answer: We fully intend to do this. Does that mean it might not happen? Yes. However, don’t assume the worst. We fully intend to transfer everything over. However, there are variables that come into play. When we get answers, you will know ASAP.

[h1]4.) ヽ༼ຈل͜ຈ༽ﾉ DONT IGNORE YOUR COMMUNITY ヽ༼ຈل͜ຈ༽ﾉ[/h1]

Answer: I know that’s not a question. However, I feel like it needs to be addressed. 

We absolutely are not ignoring you (the community). We are incredibly grateful to have all of you as players. However, if we don’t have answers, we will not make statements to you that have a possibility of falling through. Sometimes this can’t be avoided, but we are doing our best to not let it happen. We read through the Steam forums daily and you (the community) have directly influenced many awesome additions and improvements to GRAV.

notes.title: Free Weekend Recap
notes.content:
[h1]Hello GRAV Community,[/h1]

It’s been almost a week since our free weekend ended. It was fast and furious and left us with plenty of data to check out. We would like to recap our free weekend by sharing some of the more interesting stats we found:

[h1]Many New Journeys began on 11.12.15[/h1]

[img=http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/579072558702277202/DFD3A9C6D4E24931E315A470973A5BC7286E183F/]
(Image from Steam user: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=557924085]Aca40eSete[/url])

We expected the player count to grow over the free weekend and grow it did! To be exact, we saw a player increase of 82,883. Keep in mind that we can only pull data from official servers, so players on their own servers couldn’t be counted. We also had a peak concurrent player count of 6,367 and for most of the weekend; GRAV was the #1 trending game on Steam (source: [url=http://steamcharts.com]SteamCharts.com[/url])

[h1]Decades of Fun[/h1]

With the addition of over eighty-two thousand new players, we saw a very impressive total play count. If you took the overall playtime of all GRAV players during the free weekend, it would span over 3 decades! 

[h1]War Never Changes[/h1]

[img=http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/397801945114979905/4C715B280FFD70D92C944CE9114472FBDC6FC626/]
(Image from Steam user: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=555305275]killy[/url])

The total kill count was not only impressive, but it was also very interesting. Keep in mind that this data was pulled from both PvE and PvP servers. However, the total amount of players who were killed was: 50,478 or an average player kill of: 0.5 per player. That may sound high-ish, but it does not come close to total number of monster kills: 15,270,549 or an average monster kill count of: 156 monsters killed per player!

[h1]So, What About The Loot Crates?[/h1]


[img=http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/389920645766950554/CA2A8E835AB2C5BBAC2188E355851E304DDEED4C/]
(Image from Steam user: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=555278221]objetjpn[/url])

As many of you know, during the free weekend, we made it so all players had an opportunity to find free GRAV Steam keys in loot crates. However, after the free weekend ended, we noticed that not as many keys dropped as we intended. We also noticed that many player might not have noticed they even got a key, so in our recent update 5.2, we added fireworks to help queue players that you’ve gotten a key.

Also, because we didn’t give out as many keys as we would have liked, we have decided that we should give each of the top 20 free weekend players and the top 10 pre-weekend players that opened the most loot crates a free GRAV Steam key. We feel like this is a fair way to give out some more keys.

I will be reaching out to each of you on Steam, so if you receive a friend request from bitmonster_logan, please accept ☺

Speaking of being fair, we have extended the period that loot crates can drop GRAV Steam keys. We genuinely want to see players getting keys!

If you were wondering, the total amount of loot crates that were opened during the free weekend was: 230,774.

[h1]Future Community Updates[/h1]

Some of the more dedicated GRAV players may have noticed that we haven’t done an official community update post in some time. That is about to change. With that being said, we are adding some fun new additions to future posts. 

First, we are going to be giving the screenshot of the week the title of “Shutterbug of the Week” and for the short term, we will be selecting the best base of the week and giving that person the title of “Creator Overlord of the Week”.

To enter for your chance to be included in our future community updates, simply submit your screenshots in our Steam forums, or send your submissions to us at any of our social accounts: Facebook, Twitter or Reddit. You can also reach out to us, by sending an e-mail to info@bitmonstergames.com with the subject line “community update submission”

Lastly, we would like to engage and communicate with all of you more. We have some projects planned that should help out with this. To start, we will be adding a QA section to each new community update post. In this section, we will be answering questions submitted by you.

You can submit your questions on our new official [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/332500/discussions/0/492378265881640924/]Community Update QA thread[/url].

We want to thank everyone who gave GRAV a try over the weekend and we would like to welcome all the new players that have joined our growing community! Untill next time, EXPLORE BUILD DANCE SURVIVE.

notes.title: GRAV: Reborn Update 5.2 is now live!
notes.content:
[h1]GRAV: Reborn, Update 5.2 Notes[/h1]

** OFFICIAL SERVERS COMING DOWN FOR NEW PATCH! **

[h1]SPECIAL NOTICE: Since not as many people got keys as we intended, Loot crate Steam Key drops have been extended! Happy looting ;) [/h1]


[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]Player Backpacks should always appear on the compass now.  (Sometimes they could be occluded.)
[*]Move special boots to the end armor list so each full set of armor BPs can be on one page
-SHOUTOUT: Cornflakeboy
[*]Better Tutorial Text
-SHOUTOUT: Lirik
[*]When you find a free steam key we now play fireworks.  (Lots of people seemed to have missed that they got a free key)
[*]We now back up player save files more often than before
[*]If you try and build a harvester out of range of Element-X the game will warn you before proceeding.
[*]The game will now take action against non-newbie players killing newbies.
[*]Refunds for bases being destroyed now show in via a 'refund storage bin' which fixes issues with player's inventory being full at the time of the refund being awarded etc.
[/list]

 
[b]BALANCE:[/b]
[list]
[*]Home Stargates no longer require power.  (They are still found under the powered items category for ease of finding them as all the other Stargates are there)
-SHOUTOUT: Lirik
[*]Increase the drop rates of Stims
[*]Forcefield doors no longer turn off when friendly players walk through them.  This prevents other players from 'tailgating' through doors behind entering friendlies.
[*]On PvE servers, Turrets will no longer attack players near bases unless they are first attacked.
[*]On PvE servers, destroying bases and base items will no longer yield any loot for the destroyer. Furthermore, if your base is destroyed on a PvE server by a player you will be refunded the cost (and any items stored in storage bins as well).
[*]Rate at which unclaimed base items lose health has been increased.
[*]Exo planets now have 4 return portals, only one of which is in the start area of the planet.
[/list]

 
[b]BUGFIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause not enough resources to be taken when building things.
-SHOUTOUT: Mack and [>.FZ.<]Insomnia#donbit
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause problems when combining stacks in the UI.
-SHOUTOUT: Spyd3r-
[*]When trying to travel/connect to a planet that is no longer in rotation you will correctly be allowed to go to your home planet instead.
[*]Fixed possible exploit that could be used to make monsters damage shielded bases.
[*]Fixed an issue allowing high rank items to be equipped by users who were not high enough.
-SHOUTOUT: Jroc
[*]Fixed base item destruction/tampering messages going to everyone in FoF 0 if you are also in FoF 0 (0 is the not in a group fof code).
[*]Fixed an issue with drill platforms causing them not to turn on again after running out of fuel and then getting more.
[*]Fixed vehicle factory allowing things to be built even though it was not powered.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause a player's inventory to get wiped out if they crashed while driving a vehicle.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause a server's population to report lower than it actually was.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause large vehicles to lose power in low lying areas on the home planet.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause backpack icons not to appear on the compass that should have been.
[*]Fix Magmanite Boots costs
-SHOUTOUT: GravMaster
[*]Fix only the base wingsuit doing PlayerAbility 'Dive Bomb' damage
[*]Fixed other players always playing out of breath sound
-SHOUTOUT: Lirik
[*]Night Killers on Moon now have their correct Elemental Material
[/list]

-SHOUTOUT: Spyd3r-

-SHOUTOUT: Jroc

[*]Fixed an issue with drill platforms causing them not to turn on again after running out of fuel and then getting more.
[*]Fixed vehicle factory allowing things to be built even though it was not powered.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause a player's inventory to get wiped out if they crashed while driving a vehicle.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause a server's population to report lower than it actually was.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause large vehicles to lose power in low lying areas on the home planet.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause backpack icons not to appear on the compass that should have been.
[*]Fix Magmanite Boots costs
-SHOUTOUT: GravMaster
[*]Fix only the base wingsuit doing PlayerAbility 'Dive Bomb' damage
[*]Fixed other players always playing out of breath sound
-SHOUTOUT: Lirik

notes.content:

[h1]GRAV: Reborn, Update 2 Notes[/h1]

** OFFICIAL SERVERS COMING DOWN FOR NEW PATCH! **

[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]Many server side optimizations (to address lag issues on high population servers)
[*]More client-side (rendering) performance improvements on the starter planet
[*]New item! Pekket Run boots, increase movement speed.
[*]Jobs and player abilities now have a tooltip for the full description text
[*]When trying to join a planet which is full, an error message will appear indicating such as well as giving you a chance to retry.
[*]New server option: ?HomePlanetOnly - will cause the broker to only start the home planet and skip all the exo planets
[/list]


[b]BALANCE:[/b]
[list]
[*]When killing Bombers, if you and your friends do more than 60% damage to it you will receive loot even if the bomber blows up on you
-SHOUTOUT: GravMaster
[*]Reduced the chance of dropping small rations
[*]All of the various stims now have a chance of dropping
[*]Fix Armor levels.  Alien Tower Armor > Magmanite > NK
[*]Increase density of sunstone on desert planets
[*]Home planet now has some spots that have Sunstone and Tundrite
[*]Increased drop rates for Horse Head Masks
[*]When using the Uber Super Tank, you will do less damage
-SHOUTOUT: [>.FZ.<]Insomnia#donbit
[*]Magmanite stack limit increased to 5k
[*]Base decay time lowered to 24 hours.  (remember! upgrading the base item increases its base decay time, and things that are shielded or in shielded rooms never decay)
[*]Increase drop rates on Stargates
[*]Increase drop rates on Tech Hunter Crafting Materials
[/list]


[b]BUGFIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issues causing people to get bounced when trying to connect to servers for the first time
[*]Fixed being able to build on top of rooms that are shielded but the shield does not fully encompass it
-SHOUTOUT: GravMaster
[*]Fixed some cases where if you were to take all from a storage bin and then disconnect or reconnect you could end up not saving and lose the items you took from the bin
-SHOUTOUT: [>.FZ.<]Insomnia#donbit
[*]Fixed various issues with combining stacks
[*]Fixed some issues with world events
[*]Fixed monster summoner (now actually summons things reliably)
[*]Fixed issue causing timed out player bags to not get cleaned up
[*]Fix knockback playerabilities not working against monsters
-SHOUTOUT: Beast Incarnate
[*]Fix Jump Stamina Cost Reduction Cost
[*]Fixed job level requirements not showing on UI
[*]Fix not being able to drop Rations and other items
-SHOUTOUT: GravMaster
[*]Fix not getting titles from killing other players
MOTD_Text=-SHOUTOUT: GravMaster
[*]Fix winguit divebomb killing vehicles
MOTD_Text=-SHOUTOUT: GravMaster
[*]Fix Bomber loot table only including pets
[*]Can no longer use stargates without power
[*]Fixed a crash occurring when some people attempted to open the F8 keybinds menu
-SHOUTOUT: [UN] alphanuma
[*]Fixed issues with base items that require fuel using a lot of it in a big chunk when adding more after a period of it being empty.
[*]Fixed an issue with harvesters mining slower when nobody was near them.
[*]Fixed loading screens being preempted by various other menus when they should not have been.
-SHOUTOUT: [UN] alphanuma
[*]Fixed players not being returned directly to the planet they were last on as intended.
[/list]

notes.content:
[img=http://bitmonstergames.com/wp-content/uploads/GRAV_REBORN_WallPAPER.jpg]
[h1]GRAV:Reborn Update Notes[/h1]

** OFFICIAL SERVERS COMING DOWN FOR NEW UPDATE, AND SYSTEM UPDATES! **

[b]NOTICE: this patch is the biggest yet, and is a full reset for many reasons that can't be avoided.  [url=http://bitmonstergames.com/answering-that-question/]Click here for more information[/url][/b]


This patch is the result of about 3 months of hard work by the BitMonster team and has many, many changes in it.
Rather than listing them all in the usual amount of detail here are some highlights.

[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]Look for some fun Halloween surprises!
[*]New monsters have names from our contest! Thanks to all who participated.
[*]The planet the player was last on is now saved, so when you rejoin a server you will no longer have to stargate back to the planet you were previously on.
[*]Lower the overall amount of crafting materials.  Each one now comes from a specific Planet Difficulty (e.g. Low, Mid, High).
[*]Group Harvesting will give a chance to EACH harvester to get Material Drops and Resource Jackpot Drops.
[*]Pistols now all have unique visuals and sounds.  Additionally the various levels have been given more interesting names.
[*]Rocket Launchers now all have unique visuals and sounds.  Additionally the various levels have been given more interesting names.
[*]When building gear, if nothing is equipped in the new item's slot it will automatically be equipped.
[*]New drag-and-drop UI! Many aspects of how users interact with the game have been improved.
[*]All new planet: Home planet.  Vast in its land mass and full of beautiful sights to behold!
[*]In addition to the new UI inventory capacity is no longer infinite.
[*]Our old and dear friend Mr. Vendroid now finlly has some stuff in stock to sell!
[*]New Stim: Recall to uplink
[*]Pets can now be built at the factory and deployed from your inventory. (They are now consumables.)
[*]Uplinks can now be used to summon friends in your FoF group (the higher the uplink's level the more can be summoned at once)
[*]New Armor Set:  The Alien Tower Armor!
[*]New Base item: Research Station - unlock many types of base items here, as well as unlock new jobs. (Jobs no longer are exclusively dropped as blueprints)
[*]Gear progression and drop spacing been reworked to offer a much smoother experience in the early game
[*]SMGs now all have unique visuals and sounds.  Additionally the various levels have been given more interesting names.
[*]Assault Rifles now all have unique visuals and sounds.  Additionally the various levels have been given more interesting names.
[*]Active Player Skills are now active! (first one unlocks at level 10)
[*]Many new rewarded tasks/tutorials at the begining of the game.
[*]All new monster: Giant Frog
[*]All new monster: Giant Bird
[*]All new monster: Vicious Raptor
[*]All new monster: Giant Turtle
[*]New PlayerBaseItem: The Monster Summoner!  Build it and then you can call forth various monster events right at your very feet!  Looking for those pesky Day Killers?  The Monster Summoner can help you out!
[*]New Job:  The Prospector! (Still WIP more PlayerSkills Coming!)
[*]Tech Hunter kicks will now actually knock you back.
[*]A number of Client and Server optimizations.
[*]A number of Memory usage optimizations.
[/list]


[b]BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*]PVE Building Destruction Balance:  If you are breaking down a building that is not decaying then the damage is GREATLY reduced.
[*]PVE Building Destruction Balance:  If you are breaking down a building that is not decaying then you are announced to the entire server.
[/list]

notes.title: GRAV Monster Naming Contest Results
notes.content:
After announcing the 1st ever GRAV monster naming contest, we were excited to see all of your submissions. We had a ton of fun looking at all the submissions and will definitelly be doing this more often. We want to thank everyone that participated!

Now, let's see the winning names!

1.) Name: Grokkar 
     Submitted by:  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/RunnyBumCurry]RunnyBumCurry[/url]
[img=http://bitmonstergames.com/wp-content/uploads/Dino-full.jpg]

2.) Name: Snapshell
     Submitted by:  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/DropThatHero]DropThatHero[/url]
[img=http://bitmonstergames.com/wp-content/uploads/Giant_Tortog-full.jpg]

3.) Name: Pekket 
     Submitted by:  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/oojesus]Lord God-King, God[/url]
[img=http://bitmonstergames.com/wp-content/uploads/Kakar-full.jpg]

4.) Name: Ploppit
     Submitted by:  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198062655676]Haakon[/url]
[img=http://bitmonstergames.com/wp-content/uploads/Froad-full.jpg]

*.) SPECIAL
Name: Terrapinch
Submitted by: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/FaithSDK]88 Miles Per Gigawatt[/url]

Once again, we want to thank everyone that participated! Will will be holding more contests like this in the future. We want to get the GRAV community involved as much as possible, so stay tuned!

Speaking of staying tuned, we will be announcing the official release date for Reborn later today...

notes.title: Introducing The Streamer Starter Kit
notes.content:
UPDATE 8.24 //

Since launching this program, we have had a ton of requests and want to thank everyone that have reached out to us! You guys are great. However, with this flood of requests, it has made it very hard for us to reply to everyone in a timely manner, so if you haven't received a reply from us, we apologize.

We have also noticed some confusion (most likely due to the way we explained the process), so we want to take the time to clear up some things.

1.) This program is open to everyone. However, not everyone will get a key. When you message us, it's more of an application. We evaluate everyone individually. There are no requirements, so you may have only 25 followers, but get a key. We just want to make sure that we aren't giving keys to users that have either A - just created a profile for a free key or B - user has an old profile, but doesn't use it and are only linking to it to recieve a free key. 

There are other reasons, but we don't want to bore you with a long list. 

2.) We have had a few people message us about reviewing GRAV. We didn't mention reviewers in the Streamer Starter Kit becuase we didn't think about it. However, we are always open to sending keys to individuals that want to review GRAV. Keep in mind, this is an application process as well. We just want to make sure your intentions are real. Other than that, you will most likely get a key :)

Once again, we want to thank everyone that have reached out to us. It has been pretty exciting and we look forward to seeing more people covering GRAV. 

//


Hello Everyone,

Today we are announcing a new program we are calling the Streamer Starter Kit. 

Basically, we will be giving away GRAV Steam keys (the minimum is one) to *anyone that wants to cover GRAV on Twitch/YouTube. We will also mention your stream/channel on our social media profiles.

You can see all the details by [url=http://bitmonstergames.com/?p=1761]clicking here[/url].

Lastly, if you're not a streamer, but know someone who is, we would appreciate it if you could spread the word.

notes.title: Oh Patch 21, you're the one
notes.content:
[h1]PATCH 21 NOTES[/h1]

[b]** OFFICIAL SERVERS COMING DOWN FOR NEW PATCH! **[/b]


[b]NOTICE: Portuguese Translation is now in the game! (The parts that are not translated will be updated over time :-) ) [/b]
-SHOUOUT: Enjoy


[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Player Job: Hunter   Dropped from BugDog Bosses Level 7+
[*]New Weapons: Anti Vehicle Missiles!  Strong and homing against vehicles, but weak against others.
[*]New Base Item: EMP Shield Buster! Can be placed near enemy Area Totems and Drill Platforms.  Once charged, will temporarily bring down shield generators that are in range.
[*]New base item: wooden structural support
[*]Loading Screens now show some ProTips created by Rusty! If you have any tips please post them on the forums so we can include them.
-SHOUOUT: Rusty
[*]Player names that appear on base items and in the player logs now have a unique ID displayed as well.  This is to prevent players from impersonating each other, or hiding their names while doing nefarious things.
[*]New Base Item: Ladder.  Attach to any solid room wall!
[*]When interacting with a room, a pulsating cube is now drawn to indicate which room you're interacting with.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]LOD for teleporter room particle effects.
-SHOUOUT: Rusty
[*]Players can now customize the colors of rooms!
[*]Hotbar can now hold 3x as many actions via shift and control modifier keys.
[*]Add additional Crafting Material Categories: Essence, Stim Mats, and Star Material
-SHOUTOUT: L33T
[*]Allow weapon reloading when falling.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]More objects now have hit impact sounds.
[*]You can now scroll the player log to view older entries.  Using this you can view the log all the way back to the beginning of time if you want.
[*]Added server launch option to disable base decay should server operators choose to do so (add ?DoBaseDecay=0 if you want to turn base decay off)
[*]Text is now displayed when building is not allowed.  This gives useful information about what is happening, and can be localized.
[*]DEU Localization updated!
-SHOUOUT: Maxunit
[*]DEU Localization of the Protips!
-SHOUOUT: Maxunit
[*]More Protips added!
-SHOUOUT: Rusty
[*]Loading time optimizations. (reduced amount of physics cooking that needs to occur on load)
[*]SOLO PLAY:  If your planets are not rotating when you use the Stargate's 'Force Planet Rotation' button, you can now hold shift and click 'Force Planet Rotation' and the Planet Manager's Data will be reset.  This should allow you to then use the 'Force Planet Rotation' button and have the planet/moon rotate.
[*]Return Portals are now always visible on the compass.
-SHOUOUT: JIMPLEISNOTSIMPLE
[/list]

[b]BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*]Base decay value of harvesters has been increased to 4 days.
[*]Base decay times are now a multiple of the item's level.  For example, the default decay time is 48 hours, but a level 2 item decays in 96 hours and so on.
[*]Drill platform decay time increased to 4 days base.

notes.title: Patch 20 has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/FB5iO4J.jpg[/img]

[h1]PATCH 20 NOTES[/h1]

** UPDATE: OFFICIAL SERVERS NOW BACK ON-LINE **
[b]IMPORTANT NOTICES:[/b]
[list]
[*]Level ranges and caves have been re-rolled!
[*]Unattended base items now decay and will eventually be destroyed.  See below for details.
[*]Partial Portuguese Translation is now in the game!
-SHOUOUT: Enjoy
[/list]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Vehicle: Hammerhead! Three man fast moving aircraft.  Get your dogfight on!
[*]Base Decay now active! Base items that are shielded, powered, or resting on a room which is shielded will not decay. Items recently interacted with will also not decay. Otherwise after 48 hours the item will become 'unclaimed' and begin to lose health.  Unclaimed items can be claimed by anyone by interacting with them or repairing.
[*]New Base Item: Foundation ramp.  Useful if you have ladder phobia or are trying to drive a buggy into your living room!
[*]New Room! Ramp.  Allows stacking of ramp rooms for custom vehicle compatible action.
[*]Klipwc's Starter Guide is now in the Esc Menu.
-SHOUTOUT: Klipwc
[*]New pet: XP Booster!
[*]DEU Localization updated!
-SHOUOUT: Maxunit
[*]In Solo Play you can now force the rotation of the planets.
[*]Optimization: Wooden Rooms are now cheaper to render.
[*]Inventory and Storage Bins only show the categories that have items in them.
[*]More ClientSide LODing.  In this case teleporter rooms will deactivate their particle system when they go into LOD mode.
[*]When attempting to enter vehicles which are flipped, they will attempt to upright themselves.
[*]New Base Item: Automated Anti-Aircraft turret.  Powerful and long-range but only attacks things that are flying
[*]BugDog animations have all been re-done and improved.
[*]Added ground effects to tanks.
[*]Generators now turn on automatically when first built.
[*]Added 'Full screen windowed' resolution mode.
[*]Server Object Count Optimization.
[*]When no traffic has been received from a server in a while a message will be displayed indicating the connection has been interrupted.
[*]Clientside RenderThread Optimization.  When your FPS is 13 or lower we will now start turning off DynamicLights on some base items
[*]Increased max length of team messages.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]Items are now automatically placed in your hotbar if there is an empty slot.  Additionally, multitools will auto replace an existing multitool if the new one is a higher level.
[/list]


[b]BALANCE:[/b]
[list]
[*]As a Drill Platform is upgraded it will now gain a Area Level Multiplier for BluePrint Drops.  Example: A Level 6 Drill Platform in a level 14 Area will now Drop BluePrints as if it were in a Level 35 area.  NOTE:  Area Levels are the average of the min and max levels for that area.
[*]Drill Platforms when upgraded use less Plasma per time period.
[*]Centurion tanks now require Vehicle Bay to be level 5.
[*]Idle players will now be kicked after 30 minutes of idle time.
[*]Drill Platforms now drop materials of the level range they are placed in (the same as how Loot Crates do it).
[*]Fireworks no longer do damage to neither room nor base items.
[*]Getting Started In Grav steps now give our resources in addition to EXP.
[*]Vehicles now decay as well (unless parked).
[*]When repairing, don't charge crafting materials (e.g. don't charge a collapsed star core for repairing each tick)
[*]Damage dealt to higher level mobs is now scaled based on a smoother curve.
[*]Artifacts now increase the amount they will give based on what level they are (e.g. An artifact that is lvl 40 will give 2.2x as many artifacts).
-SHOUTOUT: Klipwc
[*]PVE:  You can no longer stun other Players.
[*]Newly Built Drill Platforms now start with Plasma in them (400)
[*]Teleporter rooms now have 1500 Hitpoints.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[*]Artifact Decrypters now need to be manually activated.  This allows you to have everything set up and powered and then when you want the Artifact Event to start you can then trigger it.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[/list]


[b]BUGFIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some vehicle weapons having much shorter range than intended.
[*]Fixed missing effects on Bug Dog.
-SHOUTOUT:Klipwc
[*]Fixed turrets not decaying or blowing up properly from support failures.
[*]Picking up bags will no longer try to equip whatever you were wearing at the time of death.
[*]Fixed Laser Fences not working in Solo Play.
-SHOUTOUT:Hellrazer001
[*]Fixed some cases of base items being black.
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause players to not be able to get a character once joining a server.
[*]SOLO PLAY:  Fixed Planets needing to have someone set foot on them to start their rotation.  Now you just need to look at them via a Stargate to start their rotation timer.
[*]Locator now shows the return portal location in Solo Play
-SHOUTOUT:Klipwc
[*]Fix cases where artifacts could get into a state where they no longer could be harvested/decrypted.
-SHOUTOUT:Klipwc and Beast Incarnate
[*]Fixed conditions which could cause AI to thrash and create a lot of server CPU lag
-SHOUTOUT:Glyph
[*]Fix ITA Categories being incorrect.
-SHOUTOUT: Effe
[*]Fixed weapons starting with ammo in the magazine all the time.
[*]Fixed weapons losing their ammo when traveling through a stargate.
[*]Fixed reconnecting resetting your Respawn Sickness. (No more cheesy body spamming.)
[*]Fixed not being able to insert a room below another room that has base items in it when the empty space you're trying to build in was also above a room.
-SHOUTOUT: Rustineous
[*]Fixed building support only being checked laterally.  This was preventing zigzag style support structures from working.
[*]Fix Ammo Drops sometimes didn't have in world meshes.
[*]Fix for monster names being broken in SP when running with a non-english language
-SHOUTOUT: Maxunit
[*]Fixed cases where weapon ammo was not being saved before the character save file was closed.
[*]Fixed buildings that were destroyed from a distance not saving their destruction in some circumstances.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]Fixed Storage Bin not showing its Health Bar when damaged.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]Fixed some rooms having physics collision right after they were first build.
-SHOUTOUT: Klipwc
[*]Fixed tundra cave resources not always being harvestable.
-SHOUTOUT: Klipwc
[*]Fixed Wood Balconies not having correct health.
-SHOUTOUT: Bobdamek
[*]Fix not having stereo footstep sounds for yourself
-SHOUTOUT: Zonfire
[*]Fixed the Toast Hat having inner penetration issues.
[*]Fixed Selector Categories all being off by one for French.
-SHOUTOUT: JHaze
[/list]

 [*]Sounds added to fireworks!

-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
 [/list]

notes.content:
[h1]PATCH 19 NOTES[/h1]

UPDATE: official servers are now back online

[b]IMPORTANT NOTICES:[/b]
[list]
[*]ALL Exo planets now rotate in and out of orbit at a 3 hour interval.  Just like the moons.  Let planet exploration come forth!
[*]Vehicle factory has been renamed to 'Vehicle Bay'
[/list]


[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Co-Op Vehicle Added! Doom Buggy: Fast, lightweight vehicle.  Carries two passengers as well as the driver.  Runs on organics and love.  (Boost burns plasma).
[*]GearSets are now available via (G). GearSets allow you to specify gear to wear (e.g. LowOxygen, Harvesting, PVP, etc.)  You start with 2 and every job you unlock will give you another GearSet.  You are able to name each GearSet.  You are able to make a keybind WearSelectedGearSet # (e.g. WearSelectedGearSet 4) to hotkey them.
[*]New Room type Added! Metal roof
[*]Players can now join one another's FoF group by interacting with each other. (think press E to join).  Additionally players can opt out of receiving FoF invites in the options.
[*]New room type: Wooden Bridges.  Cheap bridges available from the start.  Additionally metal bridges have had their HP increased as well as their costs.
[*]New Top Hat With Stars.  It is an Exclusive Drop for the 4th of July week!
[*]Fireworks!  Find them under the new 'Special' Selection Category in your inventory.  They are Exclusive Drops for the 4th of July week!
[*]Collision fidelity for rooms vs Vehicles has been improved.
[*]Vehicles now have horns! (Z by default, can be rebound in the keybinds menu)
[*]Added BaneElement (BE) to the Locator hud element.
-SHOUTOUT: Red Eagle LXIX
[*]Flares can now be launched from vehicles
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[*]Centurion Tanks got some updated/improved sounds.
[*]Centurion Tanks now have running lights!
[*]The names of the Driver/Gunner will now be displayed above vehicles so you can tell who is in them.
[*]Storage Bins can now have a number inputted for how much you want to take or put.
[*]There is now a button to upgrade a base item to max level in one click.
-SHOUTOUT:Airstrike
[*]When setting FoF code, a confirmation message will print to your screen indicating what code was just set.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty

[*]Automated Turrets will never fire own their owner, no matter what FoF they or their owner are in.
[*]Client base rendering performance optimizations.
[*]Server Performance Optimizations.
[*]Jump pads now work with vehicles.
[*]Unless the user otherwise overrides, the game will now automatically select the language most appropriate given the system settings of the PC playing the game.
[*]Bind location is now shown when you have a Locator
-SHOUTOUT:nyphs
[*]Pressing H to use a health stim will now use the most appropriate health stim depending on how much health you need to be healed.  (i.e. If you are down enough health to warrant using the bigger health pack, it will automatically do so)
[*]Display original owner of vehicle as well as parker when a vehicle is parked
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[*]You can now upgrade the number of vehicles you're allowed to build.
[/list]

[b]BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*]60+ mobs' health has been reduced.
[*]Composters now correctly get taxed from Area Totems.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[*]large vehicles (Doom Buggy and Ceturion Tank) can no longer be damaged by players in PvE servers.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[*]Parked vehicles can now be entered by anyone friendly to the Vehicle Bay they were parked at.  This means the Security/FoF setting of the Vehicle Factory will determine who can enter it.
[*]Better progression for the costs of Stargates' Star Materials
-SHOUTOUT:Vorl
[/list]


[b]BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix some issues causing 'white screen' and disconnects when trying to go to exo planets via stargate.
[*]Fixed some base items not giving resources when destroyed.
-SHOUTOUT:Airstrike
[*]Fixed an issue which could cause rooms not to be protected by shields after a server restart.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusticles
[*]Fixed not being able to build rooms beneath other rooms that have base items in them.
[*]Fixed a bug with the PlanetManager re-setting the launch time of the planets in orbit when entire MetaVerse was shut down.
[*]Fixed issue causing dungeon load screen to pop up when it should not have been.
[*]Fixed issue causing drivers of vehicles to be 'left behind' in some cases.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty 
[*]Fixed third person tank weapon effects (muzzleflash/sound) not showing up for other players.
[*]Changed when we attempt to spawn a Return Portal to hopefully reduce them being inside things.
-SHOUTOUT:Red Eagle LXIX
[*]Fixed an issue causing chat to fade out too quickly sometimes.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[*]Fixed room/base item upgrades not being counted toward leaderboards.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[*]Fixed several issues with very long power relay chains.
-SHOUTOUT:Klipwc
[*]Fixed Environmental Hazard Food affecting multiple Hazard Types.
-SHOUTOUT:Yee
[*]Fixed Laser Fences sometimes spawning 10s of thousands of particle beams that would crush client performance.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[*]Fixed Drill Platforms not respecting player skill for determining how many a player could build.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[*]Fixed collision issues with foundations and vehicles.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[*]Fixed being able to build doors within enemy shield generators.
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[*]Fixed Area Totems not respecting player skill for determining how many a player could build.
-SHOUTOUT:Lady
[*]Fixed Automated Turrets not firing on enemies within shield generators on PvE servers.
-SHOUTOUT:Lady
[*]Fixed some cases where the planets would never rotate in new planets.
-SHOUTOUT:Catwiesel1977
[*]Fixed kills achieved while in a tank giving more exp than intended
[*]Fixed building support check cascade causing bad performance on servers when extremely large bases have portions destroyed
-SHOUTOUT:Yee & Cell NINJA
[*]Fixed locator text while in vehicles (for reals this time)
-SHOUTOUT:Rusty
[*]Fixed world event info not showing up while in a vehicle
[*]Fixed emote animations ending when on top of moving vehicles
[/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX 18.2 HOT HOT HOT!
notes.content:
[h1]HOTFIX 18.2 Notes![/h1]

[h1]UPDATE: Official servers now back on-line [/h1]
Yesterday we noticed servers that were close to capacity were experiencing some pretty bag lag issues.  With the help of some awesome fans who jumped into experimental and assisted us in our profiling we were able to track down and fix the root cause.

So to give some relief to the players on the more populated servers we decided to roll out 18.2.  Enjoy!

[*]Clarified a number of base item descriptions.

notes.title: Patch 18! Let the race to Centurions begin!
notes.content:
[h1]PATCH 18 NOTES[/h1]
UPDATE: All servers now on-line
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4noqMUu.jpg[/img]
[b]IMPORTANT NOTICE:[/b] When you die, the hat that you are wearing will be left in your backpack.

[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]New vehicle: Centurion tank!  A large, very powerful tank. Seats two, a pilot and a main gunner. Expensive to build and operate, the Centurion offers overwhelming firepower and protection.  More multi-seat vehicles to come!
[*]Hats are now in the world!
[*]New ice caves!  Tundra caves have been re-rolled to make way for the new hot coldness.
[*] Player Soul Orbs:  When you kill another player you will gain a Player Soul Orb if that player has not been killed within the last 12 hours.  Player Soul Orbs will orbit your head showing off how bad ass you are!  If you are killed and possess any orbiting Player Soul Orbs your killer will take ALL of the orbs!!
[*]Streamer Options:  Hide Chat and Hide Player Names and Server Name.  If any streamers want other options to help fight stream sniping please let us know!
-SHOUTOUT: Lirik
[*]Sitting (via /sit) now has a lower stamina cap loss over time than standing around.
-SHOUTOUT: Mister Xiado
[*]When others are talking via VOIP an icon will be displayed above their heads, and when you are broadcasting an icon will be displayed on the HUD.
[*]ESN Localization update!
-SHOUTOUT: Jose Carlos De Luque Morales
[*]DEU Localization update!
-SHOUTOUT: Maxunit
[*]RUS Localization update!
-SHOUTOUT: Alexander Radul
[/list]

[b]BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*]Wingsuit+, Monocycle+, and Jetpack+ blueprints now only will drop if you are an active pilot job lvl 10+
-SHOUTOUT: DoD] Death-Song
[*]Item attributes have arrived!  Check out various items to see what attributes they show.  (We will be displaying more and more attributes over time.)
[*] Area Text now shows the element visually along with the Bane Element. It should now be easier to see what Elemental Type would be best to use
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty for the Bane Element Terminology
[*]Jetpack+ will now hover without needing to hold any button.
-SHOUTOUT: DoD] Death-Song
[*]Drill Platforms now erupt the Elemental Essence of the area they are in
[*]Drill Platforms now erupt Dark Gaia Elemental Essence!
[*]Drill Platforms now drop Dark Gaia Equipment BluePrints! The blueprints that drop are based off the level of the area that the Drill Platform is built in.
[*]Upgrading a room or base item will now show what is going to be improved when upgraded.
[*]Partial Controller support.  Replaced the commands that were doing debug operations.
-SHOUTOUT: kevininferno
[*]Added commandline option: -FORCEMAXLODSIZE=<4096|2048|1024|512|256|128|64|32|16>  to allow for people with lower amounts of RAM to reduce texture quality to run the game in a low RAM environment.
[*]When enabling/disabling anonymous logins a message will now display what setting is currently active.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]When an automated turret kills a player within range of a friendly data recorder, the kill will be logged.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]When first starting off only wood rooms are available to be built.  All of the other rooms will drop as blueprints in the world.  This helps the early experience to not just be overwhelming with tons and tons of room build options.
[*]Nearby area totems will now show up on the compass
[*]On PVE servers, Harvesters are now immune to damage for 2 game days when first placed.  This is to address the issue of someone following you around and just destroying any Harvester you place and you being unable to do anything about it in a PVE ruleset.  The owner can still self-destruct if they so desire.
[*]Reduce high level exo planet rotation time to 24 hours (was 36)
-SHOUTOUT: Catwiesel1977
[*]You can no longer 'wade' in magma.
[*]Area Totems per planet per person are now limited.  There is a player skill to increase the number of area totems you can control.
[*]Laser Fences no longer hurt other players in PVE
-SHOUTOUT: Appogee
[*]Players can no longer build area totems which are completely encapsulated by rooms.  The top must remain open.  This is to allow area totems (and their corresponding taxes) to have a chance at being challenged by other players.
[*]Exo planet return portals will now be re-placed in the world each time the planet instance is started up.
[/list]

[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Voice Chat dropouts and terrible sound quality.
[*]Fixed Voice Chat 'ghosting' causing old voice data to be played back at odd times.
-SHOUTOUT: Mister Xiado
[*]Fixed Bomber Material Category not showing any bomber crating materials
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]Fixed gap in collision in some dungeon chasms allowing players to leave the map.
-SHOUTOUT: Concretacus
[*]Fixed Land Mine Stunner using incorrect anim to place it in the world.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]Fixed typo in spotlight description.
-SHOUTOUT: A-Space-Turkey
[*]Fixed numerous spelling and grammatical errors.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]Fixed small gaps in collision for adjacent room pieces allowing the occasional bullet to get between room walls.
[*]Fixed numerous issues with building support calculation, causing both things to be un-buildable that should have been and things that should not have been possible, possible.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]Turrets can no longer see/shoot through player built base walls.
[*]Fixed shield generator effects on rooms.
[*]Base items protected by shields now show it in their shader (such as stargates).
[*]Fixed not being able to interact with a base item after the last interactor died or server transfered.
[*]Fixed Area Totems collecting tax off of Loot Crates which then caused them to get the last resource we added to the world (i.e. Magmanite)
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[/list]

[*]Hats are now in the world!
[*]New ice caves!  Tundra caves have been re-rolled to make way for the new hot coldness.
[*] Player Soul Orbs:  When you kill another player you will gain a Player Soul Orb if that player has not been killed within the last 12 hours.  Player Soul Orbs will orbit your head showing off how bad ass you are!  If you are killed and possess any orbiting Player Soul Orbs your killer will take ALL of the orbs!!
[*]Streamer Options:  Hide Chat and Hide Player Names and Server Name.  If any streamers want other options to help fight stream sniping please let us know!
-SHOUTOUT: Lirik
[*]Sitting (via /sit) now has a lower stamina cap loss over time than standing around.
-SHOUTOUT: Mister Xiado
[*]When others are talking via VOIP an icon will be displayed above their heads, and when you are broadcasting an icon will be displayed on the HUD.
[*]ESN Localization update!
-SHOUTOUT: Jose Carlos De Luque Morales
[*]DEU Localization update!
-SHOUTOUT: Maxunit
[*]RUS Localization update!
-SHOUTOUT: Alexander Radul

[list]
[*]Wingsuit+, Monocycle+, and Jetpack+ blueprints now only will drop if you are an active pilot job lvl 10+
-SHOUTOUT: DoD] Death-Song

[*] Area Text now shows the element visually along with the Bane Element. It should now be easier to see what Elemental Type would be best to use
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty for the Bane Element Terminology
[*]Jetpack+ will now hover without needing to hold any button.
-SHOUTOUT: DoD] Death-Song
[*]Drill Platforms now erupt the Elemental Essence of the area they are in
[*]Drill Platforms now erupt Dark Gaia Elemental Essence!
[*]Drill Platforms now drop Dark Gaia Equipment BluePrints! The blueprints that drop are based off the level of the area that the Drill Platform is built in.
[*]Upgrading a room or base item will now show what is going to be improved when upgraded.
[*]Partial Controller support.  Replaced the commands that were doing debug operations.
-SHOUTOUT: kevininferno
[*]Added commandline option: -FORCEMAXLODSIZE=<4096|2048|1024|512|256|128|64|32|16>  to allow for people with lower amounts of RAM to reduce texture quality to run the game in a low RAM environment.
[*]When enabling/disabling anonymous logins a message will now display what setting is currently active.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]When an automated turret kills a player within range of a friendly data recorder, the kill will be logged.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]When first starting off only wood rooms are available to be built.  All of the other rooms will drop as blueprints in the world.  This helps the early experience to not just be overwhelming with tons and tons of room build options.
[*]Nearby area totems will now show up on the compass
[*]On PVE servers, Harvesters are now immune to damage for 2 game days when first placed.  This is to address the issue of someone following you around and just destroying any Harvester you place and you being unable to do anything about it in a PVE ruleset.  The owner can still self-destruct if they so desire.
[*]Reduce high level exo planet rotation time to 24 hours (was 36)
-SHOUTOUT: Catwiesel1977
[*]You can no longer 'wade' in magma.
[*]Area Totems per planet per person are now limited.  There is a player skill to increase the number of area totems you can control.
[*]Laser Fences no longer hurt other players in PVE
-SHOUTOUT: Appogee
[*]Players can no longer build area totems which are completely encapsulated by rooms.  The top must remain open.  This is to allow area totems (and their corresponding taxes) to have a chance at being challenged by other players.
[*]Exo planet return portals will now be re-placed in the world each time the planet instance is started up.
[/list]

[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Voice Chat dropouts and terrible sound quality.
[*]Fixed Voice Chat 'ghosting' causing old voice data to be played back at odd times.
-SHOUTOUT: Mister Xiado
[*]Fixed Bomber Material Category not showing any bomber crating materials
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]Fixed gap in collision in some dungeon chasms allowing players to leave the map.
-SHOUTOUT: Concretacus
[*]Fixed Land Mine Stunner using incorrect anim to place it in the world.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]Fixed typo in spotlight description.
-SHOUTOUT: A-Space-Turkey
[*]Fixed numerous spelling and grammatical errors.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty
[*]Fixed small gaps in collision for adjacent room pieces allowing the occasional bullet to get between room walls.
[*]Fixed numerous issues with building support calculation, causing both things to be un-buildable that should have been and things that should not have been possible, possible.
-SHOUTOUT: Rusty

[*]Fixed shield generator effects on rooms.
[*]Base items protected by shields now show it in their shader (such as stargates).
